title: Trek — Deep Space
tagline: Clear the galaxy of hostile ships before time runs out.
teaser: Command the last ship in a sector of deep space. Type your orders, share energy between shields, engines and weapons, and clear the galaxy of hostile ships before the stardates run out. Fly the ten sorties of the Frontier Tour for rank, or the same Daily Patrol as everyone else.

manPage.synopsis: trek — navigate the galaxy, manage energy, win the campaign.
manPage.description: Eric Allman’s turn-based space command game, one of the earliest programs in the BSD games directory.

howToPlay: Type commands like “move”, “phaser” or “torpedo”; ? opens help.
Scan, warp between quadrants and dock to refuel and repair.
Clear every hostile ship in time; each sortie and patrol has three commendations to earn.

packages.title: True aim
packages.description: Land a torpedo squarely on a hostile hull.

packages.title: Safe harbour
packages.description: Dock at a starbase and let its crew patch you up.

packages.description: Clear a quadrant that held three or more hostile ships.

packages.title: Double volley
packages.description: Disable two ships with one phaser volley.

packages.title: Hold together
packages.description: Win after your hull fell below a quarter.

packages.title: Self-reliant

packages.title: Full survey

packages.title: Against the odds
